subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should existing bundled skill descriptions be expanded with compact WHAT+WHEN trigger wording now, or should exact trigger selection wait for the structured triggers-field contract?
rationale: Current main still uses descriptions as the prompt-visible selection signal, but docs also constrain description length and a related issue proposes a new trigger metadata contract, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve compact description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that adds short WHEN wording without long keyword lists or new routing behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions concise for now and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 to decide exact trigger metadata and routing semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-style descriptions are intentional and close or redirect related partial cleanup attempts.

recommendation.title: Approve compact description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that adds short WHEN wording without long keyword lists or new routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is recent bundled-skill guidance and description-policy history in docs and embedded skills.
